blocks.body:
name = "acme/judges-more-values"
version = "1.0.0"
[verifier.judges.agent]
resources = "big"
views = "x"
budget = 5

[verifier.judges.llm]
model = ["a"]
resources = {}
views = []
budget = { cost = 1 }

[verifier.judges.panel]
model = ["a", 3]

diagnostics.message: [verifier.judges.llm] resources is for the agent role only: an llm judge is one model call with the evidence inline
[verifier.judges.llm] views is for the agent role only: an llm judge is one model call with the evidence inline
[verifier.judges.llm] budget is a table of tokens and tool_calls
[verifier.judges.agent] budget is a table of tokens and tool_calls
[verifier.judges.agent] resources is a table of cpus, disk, gpu_types, gpus, memory, tpu
[verifier.judges.agent] views is a list of { path, format = "trajectory-1" } tables, the files the runtime writes for the judge from its own records
[verifier.judges.panel] model names a model, or a list of them for a panel
the agent judge has no token budget ([verifier.judges.agent] budget = { tokens = ... }): here it is bounded by its timeout, 20m, but purpose = "rl" and delivery grade require one
